children: Tripathy joins after more than 18 years at Philips, bringing extensive finance leadership experience across healthcare technology and international markets
Integris Medtech has appointed Dev Tripathy as Group Chief Financial Officer (CFO), marking his move to the Indian medical technology company after more than 18 years with Philips.

Tripathy most recently served as CFO, India Subcontinent and Head of Finance at Philips, where he held several senior finance roles across businesses and geographies. His experience at the company included leadership positions in Health Systems, Personal Health, Corporate Functions and financial planning and analysis.

In his new role, Tripathy will lead Integris Medtech’s group finance function, with responsibility for financial strategy, capital allocation, governance, risk management and strengthening financial processes as the company expands its international operations. Integris Medtech operates across 65 countries, with manufacturing facilities in India, Germany and the Netherlands.

Before joining Philips, Tripathy was Controller at AB Mauri India and began his career at Tata Steel. A Chartered Accountant, he has also completed a programme in Strategy and Business Decision Making from the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad.
